records.meaning: One bounded reasoning objective with an attributable intent, a frozen question or conclusion domain, selected source handles, constraints, and protected effects.
A provenance-bearing set of candidate context items with source, authority, temporal, relevance, and revision metadata.
One raw request plus an explicit or inferred request context whose posture and evidence remain visible during capability selection.
A bounded context envelope that states included and excluded material, digests, contradictions, gaps, freshness, and the claim ceiling for one reasoning run.

A request-relative, digest-bound semantic substrate containing the preserved request, selected route, route-profiled definition closure, declared ontology selector lock, authority and effect posture, constraints, exclusions, gaps, and residue required before route-owned strategy or work.

An immutable consumer-specific projection of one Context Basis with an explicit plan-bound or interaction-bound identity lane, source epoch, predecessor or reuse evidence, exclusions, residue, and no authority effect.
Exactly one typed semantic disposition with its reasoning receipt, support, defeaters, unresolved residue, input identities, and non-authorizing posture.
One complete, direct, gate, or block disposition with admissible options, consequence reasons, owner-gate requirements, provenance digests, and no authority effect.
One exact proposal-scoped constraint derived from a verified Reasoning Receipt, preserving advisory, ineligible, owner-gated, or no-op posture without granting effect authority.
One immutable digest-bound cut of compact per-turn runtime events suitable for deterministic external-call-free replay.
One immutable content-addressed selection of exact reasoning events, dependencies, context identity, consumer, request, and continuation frontier.
One exactly reconstructable canonical model request bound to a Reasoning State epoch and provider, model, system, tool, and configuration header.
One non-authorizing digest-bound receipt that a verified reasoning-state epoch was flushed at a declared pre-request, pre-effect, or pre-continuation boundary.
One deterministic disposable index derived solely from a verified canonical Reasoning State record stream, containing event, epoch, checkpoint, and head identities without becoming source authority.
One non-authorizing assessment that binds exact log bytes, derived-index identity, final checkpoint, recovery disposition, and zero-external-call posture before a recovered ledger can accept work.

One content-addressed completed reasoning frontier binding the exact completion subject, context and prior-epoch identities, explicit semantic result, continuation result, and non-authorizing posture to a verified after-completion checkpoint.
One declared consumer and lane bound to an isolated in-memory wrapper and upstream app-server connection under a distinct gateway runtime epoch.
Select only material relevant to the frozen objective, declared dependencies, owner scopes, and evidence obligations; record exclusions instead of silently broadening context.
Preserve source identity, transformations, digests, authority posture, contradictions, and unresolved gaps through selection and compression.
Changed selected dependencies create a new context epoch; historical replay remains distinct from current revalidation and stale results cannot be silently reused.
Context selection, semantic judgment, validation, consensus, and receipt persistence never become owner authority or exact-effect permission.
Select the nearest uniquely supported capability directly; Goal participates only when goal-specific request evidence matches and is never a fallback.
After completion, continue only through a sole non-consequential option; route multiple or consequential options to their configured Decision Gate and block zero admissible options.

Compute request-relative definition closure as the least fixed point of universal normative relation classes plus additions declared by the selected route profile; preserve exact definition identity, version or revision, digest, authority posture, and typed semantic gaps.

Bind owner-declared required ontology nodes and edges recursively with typed exclusions and exact digests; a versioned omission audit may report candidates but cannot widen the lock, admit or reject records, route, continue, or authorize.

Retain an unchanged plan-bound view only with an exact per-turn reuse receipt; create a successor for every interaction-bound human or chat turn and whenever any selected dependency or protected binding changes.

Reuse explicit provenance-bound reasoning products through append-only events and immutable epochs; treat Context Envelopes as projections and request caches as optimizations rather than sources of truth.
Fail closed unless the selected Reasoning State epoch and exact dispatch are verified and flushed before a model request, accepted effect, or automatic continuation crosses its boundary.

Recover only from a fully verified canonical record stream ending at a valid checkpoint; block torn, malformed, tampered, mixed-ledger, unknown, source-drifted, or uncheckpointed state without rewriting or silently truncating bytes.

Checkpoint the exact completed-turn semantic and continuation state before automatic continuation; replay an equal completion with zero external calls, block changed bytes under the same identity, and never guess or retry an unacknowledged downstream delivery after recovery.

Before semantic reduction, verify exact agreement among the Context Envelope binding, bound Problem Frame, entry gate, authority snapshot, selected Context Item digests, freshness, and claim ceiling; bind those identities into context-bound receipts without changing historical unbound receipt bytes.

Turn exact benchmark and runtime observations into one measurable target, exact research and reproduction records, isolated variants, and fixed comparisons while keeping research and fitness non-authorizing.
Keep recommend-only as the default; any explicitly enabled controlled-local activation must bind its predecessor and rollback target, run a canary, and restore the predecessor after failure.
Bounded legacy evidence for deterministic semantic reduction and reasoning-receipt assembly; not a complete engine or context manager.
Bounded legacy evidence for advisory intent-route resolution over prepared inputs; not a dispatcher or general context manager.
Candidate local realization of profile-verified direct capability routing and configurable consequence/cardinality evaluation; it performs no capability or effect.
Candidate local realization of immutable hash-chained in-memory events, verified cuts, deterministic replay, idempotency, and closed-turn-only eviction; not durable storage.
Candidate Codex realization that verifies receipt and turn bindings before constraining explicitly dependent proposals while preserving structural consequence and authority boundaries.

Candidate local realization of isolated lane-bound consumer sessions across direct stdio, managed-daemon proxy, or loopback WebSocket app-server transports with bounded reconnect and no durable state.

Candidate local realization of append-only explicit reasoning events and epochs, risk-aligned memory or fsync checkpoints, and exact Codex request reconstruction; file-log recovery and distributed durability remain absent.

Candidate local realization of canonical log verification, deterministic disposable-index rebuilding, final-checkpoint selection, exact ledger hydration, and Codex startup recovery; repair, compaction, cross-process locking, and Session semantics remain absent.

Candidate local realization of append-only completed-turn frontier sealing, after-completion checkpointing, file recovery, and zero-call Codex completion replay with at-most-once successor posture; delivery acknowledgement remains absent.
Candidate local realization of fail-closed context-binding verification and context-bearing Reasoning Receipts with byte-compatible legacy unbound evaluation.

Candidate local realization of append-only improvement records, deterministic target selection, provider-neutral research, reproduction and content-addressed variant records, exact benchmark comparison, isolated single-writer variant workspaces, serialized cycles, recommend-only defaults, and canary rollback.

Intent preservation, fast direct routing, route-profiled definition closure, declared ontology selector locking, Necessary Context Basis construction, dual-lane immutable Context Window Views, bounded context selection, provenance integrity, contradiction and exclusion visibility, freshness and invalidation, fail-closed context-bound semantic integrity, typed semantic outcomes, deterministic reuse and reasoning receipts, fail-closed checkpointed recovery, completed-turn frontier replay, abstention, replay separation, authority non-collapse, and explicit realization gaps.

residue.meaning: The bounded candidate realizes fast routing, definition closure, selector locking, Context Basis and dual-lane views, inline envelopes, refresh and invalidation, semantic input and reduction, receipt-constrained continuation, in-memory journal replay, checkpointed Reasoning State file recovery, completed-turn frontier replay, and isolated persistent app-server consumer sessions. Production semantic activation, delivery acknowledgement, adaptive compression, cross-process recovery coordination, and supported Codex Desktop adoption remain open.

The working Codex candidate composes the bounded libraries behind a local persistent gateway, recovers one checkpointed Reasoning State file, and replays exact completed-turn frontiers, but no production semantic-domain catalog or default activation is adopted, delivery acknowledgement, cross-process coordination, and repair are absent, Desktop integration is unproved, and the full engine is not admitted or generally hosted.
The package-local DomainSpec development profile and generated system ontology are candidates and are not admitted.
No owner-accepted baseline binds the implementation target to this exact generated system ontology.
Static and runtime conformance cannot be evaluated before an exact implementation binding exists.
The configurable decision model is candidate runtime behavior and is not an adopted governance or authority gate.
